title: AWS Glue 5.0 is now generally available
body_text: AWS Glue 5.0 is now generally available. Glue 5.0 upgrades the engine to Apache Spark 3.5.2, Python 3.11 and Java 17, and updates support for Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi and Delta Lake. AWS Glue 5.0 is available in 14 AWS Regions, including US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland).

title: Introducing Amazon Aurora DSQL (Preview)
body_text: Today at AWS re:Invent we are announcing the preview of Amazon Aurora DSQL, a serverless, distributed SQL database with virtually unlimited scale. Aurora DSQL is PostgreSQL-compatible and has no infrastructure to manage. During the preview, Aurora DSQL is available in the US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio) and US West (Oregon) Regions. Aurora DSQL is free to use during the preview.

title: Announcing Amazon S3 Tables - Fully managed Apache Iceberg tables optimized for analytics workloads
body_text: Amazon S3 Tables are now generally available. S3 Tables deliver storage optimized for Apache Iceberg tables, with up to 3x faster query performance and automatic compaction. S3 Tables are available in the US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio) and US West (Oregon) Regions.

title: Amazon EC2 Trn2 instances and Trn2 UltraServers for AI/ML training and inference are now available
body_text: Today we are announcing general availability of Amazon EC2 Trn2 instances, powered by AWS Trainium2, and a preview of Trn2 UltraServers. Each Trn2 instance has 16 Trainium2 chips. Trn2 instances are generally available in the US East (Ohio) Region through EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML.

title: Amazon Bedrock - Build generative AI applications and agents at production scale
body_text: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed service that offers a choice of high-performing foundation models through a single API. Use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to deploy and operate agents securely at scale. See the Region table for model availability.

title: Introducing Amazon Nova foundation models, available in Amazon Bedrock
body_text: Amazon Nova is a new generation of foundation models. Amazon Nova Micro, Lite and Pro are generally available today in Amazon Bedrock in the US East (N. Virginia) Region, and in US West (Oregon) and US East (Ohio) through cross-Region inference.

title: Announcing Amazon EKS Auto Mode
body_text: Amazon EKS Auto Mode is now generally available. EKS Auto Mode automates Kubernetes cluster management for compute, storage and networking. EKS Auto Mode is available in all commercial AWS Regions except China Regions.

title: Amazon Q Developer is now available in preview in GitHub
body_text: Amazon Q Developer is now available in preview in GitHub. Assign an issue to Amazon Q Developer and the agent writes the code, opens a pull request and responds to review comments. The preview is free to use and does not require an AWS account.

title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio is now generally available
body_text: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio is now generally available. It brings data, analytics and AI tools into one environment, with Amazon Q Developer built in. It is available in US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Europe (Frankfurt) and other Regions.

title: Amazon Aurora DSQL - Serverless distributed SQL database
body_text: Amazon Aurora DSQL is the fastest serverless distributed SQL database for always available applications. Aurora DSQL is PostgreSQL-compatible and scales reads, writes, compute and storage automatically. Single-Region clusters are designed for 99.99% availability and multi-Region clusters for 99.999% availability. See the Aurora DSQL documentation for the current list of supported Regions.

title: AWS Lambda SnapStart for Python and .NET functions is now generally available in additional Regions
body_text: AWS Lambda SnapStart for Python and .NET functions is now generally available in additional Regions: Asia Pacific (Hyderabad), Asia Pacific (Melbourne), Europe (Spain) and Europe (Zurich). SnapStart delivers up to 10x faster function startup.

title: Amazon DynamoDB global tables with multi-Region strong consistency is now generally available
body_text: Multi-Region strong consistency for Amazon DynamoDB global tables is now generally available. You can build applications with a Recovery Point Objective of zero. The feature is available in US, Europe and Asia Pacific Region sets.

title: Introducing Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: Securely deploy and operate AI agents at any scale (preview)
body_text: Today we are announcing the preview of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a set of services to deploy and operate AI agents securely at scale using any framework and any model. AgentCore includes Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Code Interpreter, Browser and Observability. During the preview, AgentCore is available in the US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Sydney) and Europe (Frankfurt) Regions. You can use AgentCore services at no charge until September 16, 2025.

title: Amazon S3 Vectors (Preview): native support for storing and querying vectors
body_text: Amazon S3 Vectors is now available in preview. S3 Vectors is the first cloud object store with native support to store and query vectors, and can reduce the cost of uploading, storing and querying vectors by up to 90%. Each vector bucket holds up to 10,000 vector indexes. S3 Vectors integrates with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Amazon OpenSearch Service. The preview is available in the US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Europe (Frankfurt) and Asia Pacific (Sydney) Regions.

title: Amazon S3 Vectors
body_text: Amazon S3 Vectors is purpose-built, cost-optimized vector storage for AI agents, inference and semantic search. Store vector embeddings in vector buckets and run similarity queries with subsecond response times, with no infrastructure to provision. Amazon S3 Vectors is in preview and is available in five AWS Regions.

title: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available
body_text: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available. Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database with virtually unlimited scale, active-active high availability, PostgreSQL compatibility and no infrastructure to manage. Single-Region clusters offer 99.99% availability and multi-Region clusters offer 99.999% availability. Aurora DSQL is available in the following AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Osaka), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Europe (Ireland), Europe (London) and Europe (Paris).

title: Amazon EC2 P6e-GB200 UltraServers accelerated by NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs are now available
body_text: Amazon EC2 P6e-GB200 UltraServers, accelerated by NVIDIA GB200 NVL72, are now available. A single P6e-GB200 UltraServer offers up to 72 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs interconnected with fifth-generation NVIDIA NVLink and 13.4 TB of high-bandwidth GPU memory. P6e-GB200 UltraServers are available through EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML in the Dallas Local Zone (us-east-1-dfw-2a), an extension of the US East (N. Virginia) Region.

title: Amazon EC2 P6 Instances
body_text: Amazon EC2 P6 instances, accelerated by NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, deliver high performance for AI training and inference. P6-B200 instances offer 8 NVIDIA B200 GPUs. P6e-GB200 UltraServers connect up to 72 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in one NVLink domain. For Regional availability, see the EC2 instance types by Region page.

title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available
body_text: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available. AgentCore is an agentic platform to build, deploy and operate AI agents securely at scale, using any framework and any foundation model. AgentCore adds support for VPC, AWS PrivateLink and AWS CloudFormation. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is available in nine AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Europe (Frankfurt) and Europe (Ireland).

title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
body_text: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore lets you deploy and operate highly effective agents securely at scale using any framework and model. Use Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Browser, Code Interpreter and Observability together or independently. Pay only for what you use.

title: Amazon Braket introduces program sets to run quantum workloads faster
body_text: Amazon Braket, the quantum computing service from AWS, now supports program sets. A program set bundles up to 100 quantum circuits into a single quantum task, which reduces overhead for variational algorithms. Program sets are available on supported quantum processing units in all AWS Regions where Amazon Braket is available.

title: Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights is now generally available in additional Regions
body_text: Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights is now generally available in additional Regions: Africa (Cape Town), Asia Pacific (Jakarta), Europe (Milan) and Israel (Tel Aviv). Database Insights gives a single view of fleet health for Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS.

title: Amazon Q Developer - The most capable generative AI-powered assistant for software development
body_text: Amazon Q Developer helps you write, test, review and transform code in your IDE, the command line and the AWS Management Console. Amazon Q Developer offers a Free Tier and a Pro tier at $19 per user per month.

title: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 is now in Amazon Bedrock
body_text: Claude Sonnet 4.5, Anthropic's most capable model for coding and complex agents, is now available in Amazon Bedrock. It is available through global cross-Region inference and through US, EU, Japan and Australia cross-Region inference profiles.

title: New Amazon EC2 P6-B200 instances powered by NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs to accelerate AI innovations
body_text: Today we are announcing general availability of Amazon EC2 P6-B200 instances, accelerated by NVIDIA B200 GPUs. P6-B200 instances offer up to 2x the performance of P5en instances for AI training. P6-B200 instances are available in the US West (Oregon) Region through EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML and Savings Plans.

title: Amazon ECS announces built-in blue/green deployments
body_text: Amazon ECS now supports built-in blue/green deployments, so you can shift traffic to a new service revision and roll back quickly without custom tooling. The feature is available in all commercial AWS Regions.

title: Amazon SageMaker - The center for all your data, analytics, and AI
body_text: The next generation of Amazon SageMaker brings together AWS machine learning and analytics capabilities. Use SageMaker Unified Studio to reach your data and tools, with governance built in through Amazon SageMaker Catalog.

title: Maximize accelerator utilization with new Amazon SageMaker HyperPod task governance
body_text: SageMaker HyperPod task governance is now generally available. Administrators set compute quotas and priorities per team, and HyperPod lends idle accelerators to other teams. It works with HyperPod clusters orchestrated by Amazon EKS.

title: Amazon ElastiCache now supports Valkey 8.1
body_text: Amazon ElastiCache now supports Valkey 8.1, which adds native Bloom filter support and reduces memory usage. Valkey 8.1 is available in all AWS Regions where ElastiCache is available, at no additional cost.

title: Amazon DynamoDB - Serverless, fully managed NoSQL database
body_text: Amazon DynamoDB is a serverless, fully managed, distributed NoSQL database with single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. Global tables provide multi-active replication across AWS Regions with up to 99.999% availability.

title: Amazon S3 Metadata is now generally available
body_text: Amazon S3 Metadata is now generally available. S3 Metadata captures object metadata in near real time and stores it in fully managed Apache Iceberg tables that you can query with SQL. It is available in the US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio) and US West (Oregon) Regions.

title: Amazon Redshift adds support for querying Apache Iceberg tables in Amazon S3 Tables
body_text: You can now use Amazon Redshift to query Apache Iceberg tables stored in Amazon S3 Tables. This feature is available in all AWS Regions where both Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3 Tables are available.

title: Amazon GuardDuty expands Extended Threat Detection coverage to Amazon EKS clusters
body_text: Amazon GuardDuty Extended Threat Detection now detects multistage attacks that target Amazon EKS clusters by correlating audit logs, runtime behavior and API activity. It is available in all AWS Regions where GuardDuty is available.

title: AWS Lambda - Serverless compute
body_text: AWS Lambda runs code without provisioning or managing servers. You pay only for the compute time you consume, starting at $0.20 per 1 million requests. Lambda SnapStart reduces startup latency for Java, Python and .NET functions.

title: Amazon Nova Premier: Our most capable model for complex tasks and teacher for model distillation
body_text: Amazon Nova Premier is now generally available in Amazon Bedrock. Nova Premier accepts text, image and video input with a one million token context window. It is available in US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio) and US West (Oregon) through cross-Region inference.

title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL supports minor versions 17.5, 16.9, 15.13, 14.18 and 13.21
body_text: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL now supports minor versions 17.5, 16.9, 15.13, 14.18 and 13.21, with bug fixes and security improvements. The new versions are available in all commercial AWS Regions and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions.

title: Amazon EKS enables ultra-scale AI/ML workloads with support for 100K nodes per cluster
body_text: Amazon EKS now supports up to 100,000 worker nodes in a single cluster for AI/ML training and inference. Contact your AWS account team to enable ultra scale clusters.

title: Amazon CloudWatch - Observe and monitor resources and applications
body_text: Amazon CloudWatch collects metrics, logs and traces from AWS resources and applications. Use Application Signals and Database Insights for curated monitoring, and use CloudWatch generative AI observability to monitor agents built with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

title: New general-purpose Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available
body_text: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors, are now generally available. They are available in US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Spain).

title: Amazon Q Developer is now available in the Europe (Frankfurt) Region
body_text: Amazon Q Developer Pro tier subscribers can now use Amazon Q Developer in the Europe (Frankfurt) Region, with data stored in Frankfurt. Amazon Q Developer is also available in US East (N. Virginia).
